zh: 致谢

十多年来，我有机会在公开讲座和研讨会上发展本书的想法。我感谢所有邀请和接待我的人，也感谢许多贡献了思考的评论人和参与者。这些场合包括：巴黎政治学院 AIME 工作坊，2014 年；西悉尼大学“知识、文化、经济”会议，2014 年；牛津大学环境变化研究所，2014 年；卢塞恩大学人文与社会科学研究生院，2014 年；哥本哈根大学埃斯特·博塞鲁普奖讲座，2015 年；威廉姆斯学院 Log Luncheon，2015 年；加州大学欧文分校全球和平与冲突研究中心，2015 年；牛津大学全球史中心，2016 年；卫斯理大学人文中心，2017 年；科尔盖特大学里丁讲座（Reading Lecture），2017 年；卡内基梅隆大学“能源文化”会议，2017 年；哈佛大学全球史研讨班，2017 年和 2024 年；威尼斯圣乔治对话，2017 年；新学院罗伯特·L. 海尔布隆纳资本主义研究中心，2017 年；柏林马克斯·普朗克科学史研究所，2017 年；加州大学圣巴巴拉分校梅隆·索耶“全球视野下的能源正义”研讨班，2018 年；卡塔尔多哈研究生院，2018 年；西北大学克洛普斯特格讲座，2018 年；比尔宰特大学易卜拉欣·阿布-卢戈德国际研究所，2018 年；哈佛大学“多重碳”工作坊，2019 年；巴斯大学全球政治研究所，2019 年和 2020 年；坎帕拉马凯雷雷社会研究所，2020 年；埃克塞特大学海湾研究中心，2022 年；伦敦大学亚非学院沃尔特
·罗德尼历史研究集体，2022 年；隆德大学人类生态学系，2023 年；奥斯陆大学埃勒特·松特讲座，2024 年；斯德哥尔摩皇家理工学院“群岛讲座”，2024 年。
en: Over more than a decade, I have had the opportunity to develop the ideas for this book in public lectures and seminars. I am grateful to all those who invited and hosted me and to the many commentators and participants who contributed their thoughts. The occasions include the AIME Workshop, Sciences Po, Paris, 2014; the Knowledge Culture Economy conference, University of Western Sydney, 2014; the Environmental Change Institute, Oxford, 2014; the Graduate School of Humanities and Social Sciences, University of Lucerne, 2014; the Ester Boserup Prize Lecture, University of Copenhagen, 2015; the Log Luncheon, Williams College, 2015; the Center for Global Peace and Conflict Studies, UC Irvine, 2015; the Oxford Centre for Global History, 2016; the Center for the Humanities, Wesleyan University, 2017; the Reading Lecture, Colgate University, 2017; the Cultures of Energy conference, Carnegie Mellon University, 2017; the Harvard Global History Seminar, 2017 and 2024; the Dialogue of San Giorgio, Venice, 2017; the Robert L. Heilbroner Center for Capitalism Studies, the New School, 2017; the Max Planck Institute for the History of Science, Berlin, 2017; the Mellon Sawyer Seminar on Energy Justice in Global Perspective, UC Santa Barbara, 2018; the Doha Institute for Graduate Studies, Qatar, 2018; the Klopsteg Lecture, Northwestern University, 2018; the Ibrahim Abu-Lughod Institute of International Studies, Birzeit University, 2018; the Multiple Carbons workshop, Harvard University, 2019; the Institute for Global Politics, University of Bath, 2019 and 2020; the Makerere Institute of Social Research, Kampala, 2020; the Centre for Gulf Studies, University of Exeter, 2022; the Walter

Rodney Collective for Historical Research, SOAS University of London, 2022; the Human Ecology Division, Lund University, 2023; the Eilert Sundt Lecture, University of Oslo, 2024; and the Archipelago Lecture, KTH Stockholm, 2024.

zh: 在 Verso 出版社，编辑总监 Sebastian Budgen 多年来一直鼓励这个项目。我感谢他、制作编辑 Nick Walther 以及出版社全体工作人员所做的工作。我还有幸得到几位研究助理的帮助：Rosa Klein-Baer、Dalia Ghaith、Rebecca Glade、Naye Idriss 和 Noam Chen-Zion。他们对本书写作的贡献弥足珍贵。
en: At Verso Books, the editorial director Sebastian Budgen has encouraged this project for many years. I am grateful to him, the production editor, Nick Walther, and all the staff at the press for their work. I was also fortunate to have the help of a series of research assistants: Rosa Klein-Baer, Dalia Ghaith, Rebecca Glade, Naye Idriss, and Noam Chen-Zion. Their input to the writing of the book was invaluable.

zh: 2022—2023 年，我受邀在普林斯顿高等研究院社会科学学院担任访问教授一年。本书的大部分内容是在那里写成或修订的。我感谢 Wendy Brown 邀请我共同主持该学院当年的“气候危机政治”主题研讨班，感谢她在学院的同事 Didier Fassin、Alondra Nelson 和 Joan Scott，感谢工作人员，尤其是 Miriam Harris 和 Munirah Bishop，也感谢参与主题研讨班的成员；他们许多人为我的章节草稿提供了详细意见。
en: In 2022–3, I was invited to spend the year as Visiting Professor in the School of Social Science at the Institute for Advanced Study, Princeton. Much of this book was written or revised there. I am grateful to Wendy Brown for the invitation to codirect the School’s theme seminar that year on Climate Crisis Politics, to her colleagues at the School, Didier Fassin, Alondra Nelson, and Joan Scott, to the staff, especially Miriam Harris and Munirah Bishop, and to the members who collaborated on the theme seminar, in many cases offering detailed comments on my draft chapters.

zh: 在哥伦比亚大学，多年来我受益于与中东、南亚和非洲研究系同事的讨论，尤其是 Wael Hallaq、Gil Hochberg、Sudipta Kaviraj、Mahmood Mamdani、Debashree Mukherjee 和
Jennifer Wenzel，也受益于 Jessica Rechtschaffer 领导的行政工作人员的支持。我在期刊

zh: 的共事编辑，尤其是 Anupama Rao，为我提供了许多想法。纽约及周边地区还有许多朋友和同事与我分享想法和谈话，有些已持续数十年，包括 Gil Anidjar、Talal Asad、Koray Çalışkan、Julia Elyachar、Michael Gilsenan、Robert Vitalis 和已故的 Brinkley Messick。我也感谢其他地方阅读并评论各章草稿的同事，尤其是 Brett Christophers、Jennifer Derr、Jonathan Levy、Zachary Lockman 和 Keith Tribe。
en: At Columbia University I have benefited over the years from discussions with colleagues in the Department of Middle Eastern, South Asian and African Studies, in particular Wael Hallaq, Gil Hochberg, Sudipta Kaviraj, Mahmood Mamdani, Debashree Mukherjee, and
Jennifer Wenzel, and from the support of the administrative staff, led by Jessica Rechtschaffer. My coeditors at the journal

children: Comparative Studies of South Asia, Africa and the Middle East

en: , in particular Anupama Rao, have been the source of numerous ideas. Many other friends and colleagues in and around New York have shared ideas and conversations, in some cases over decades, including Gil Anidjar, Talal Asad, Koray Çalışkan, Julia Elyachar, Michael Gilsenan, Robert Vitalis, and the late Brinkley Messick. I am also grateful to colleagues elsewhere who read and commented on drafts of various chapters, in particular Brett Christophers, Jennifer Derr, Jonathan Levy, Zachary Lockman, and Keith Tribe.

zh: 在写作本书的这些年里，哥伦比亚大学的许多研究生参加了我的殖民主义与技术政治研讨班。他们大多直接或间接地对塑造本书的思考有所贡献。其中几位后来撰写了博士学位论文，我直接从他们的论文中汲取了想法，包括 Casey Primel、Shehab Ismail、Timothy Shenk、Onur Ozgode、Alaa El-Shafei 和 Nadeem Mansour。有三位在本书写作全程都在我身边，与我分享了许多谈话：Rana Baker、Ibrahim Elhoudaiby 和 Hengameh Ziai。我特别感谢他们。
en: During the years of writing this book, numerous graduate students at Columbia have participated in my seminars on colonialism and technopolitics. Most of them contributed, directly or indirectly, to the thinking that has shaped the book. Several of them went on to write PhD dissertations from which I have directly drawn ideas, including Casey Primel, Shehab Ismail, Timothy Shenk, Onur Ozgode, Alaa El-Shafei, and Nadeem Mansour. Three of them were around throughout the writing of the book and shared many conversations: Rana Baker, Ibrahim Elhoudaiby, and Hengameh Ziai. To them I owe special thanks.

zh: 这些年来，在我写作本书的过程中，Adie 和 JJ Mitchell 与 Chloe、Jesse 一起走着自己的人生道路，也与这本书同行。我们共同经历的许多探险，无论在水路已明还是未明之处，都集中体现了这种共同生活的全部挑战与欢乐。Lila Abu-Lughod 分享这些年的每一刻。她的建议、她的智慧和她的爱，对本书的写作以及我们共同生活的每一个部分都不可或缺。最后，我的五个兄弟姐妹始终以怀疑、幽默和支持的恰当混合，支持我的每一项事业。本书献给他们。
en: As I worked on this writing over the years, Adie and JJ Mitchell charted their own lives, along with Chloe and Jesse, while also sharing the journey of this book. Our numerous adventures together, on waters charted and uncharted, epitomise all the challenges and joys of that shared life. Lila Abu-Lughod shared every moment of these years. Her counsel, her intellect, and her love have been indispensable to the writing of the book and to every part our life together. Finally, my five siblings have always provided for every undertaking the proper mix of scepticism, humour, and support. The book is dedicated to them.
